title: The Conformational Space of the SARS-CoV-2 Main Protease Active Site Loops is Determined by Ligand Binding and Interprotomer Allostery
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD模拟研究SARS-CoV-2主蛋白酶柔性环构象与变构，对象为蛋白-小分子配体而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽为物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: The main protease (M pro ) of SARS-CoV-2 is essential for viral replication and is, therefore, an important drug target. Here, we investigate two flexible loops in M pro that play a role in catalysis. Using all-atom molecular dynamics simulations, we analyze the structural ensemble of M pro in an apo state and substrate-bound state. We find that the flexible loops can adopt open, intermediate (partly open) and closed conformations in solution, which differs from the partially closed state observed in crystal structures of M pro . When the loops are in closed or intermediate states, the catalytic residues are more likely to be in close proximity, which is crucial for catalysis. Additionally, we find that substrate binding to one protomer of the homodimer increases the frequency of intermediate states in the bound protomer, while also affecting the structural propensity of the apo protomer’s flexible loops. Using dynamic network analysis, we identify multiple allosteric pathways connecting the two active sites of the homodimer. Common to these pathways is an allosteric hotspot involving the N-terminus, a critical region that comprises part of the binding pocket. Taken together, the results of our simulation study provide detailed insight into the relationships between the flexible loops and substrate binding in a prime drug target for COVID-19.
abstract_zh: SARS-CoV-2的主蛋白酶（M pro）对病毒复制至关重要，因此是一个重要的药物靶点。在此，我们研究了M pro中两个在催化过程中起作用的柔性环。利用全原子分子动力学模拟，我们分析了M pro在无配体状态和底物结合状态下的结构系综。我们发现，这些柔性环在溶液中可以呈现开放、中间（部分开放）和闭合构象，这与M pro晶体结构中观察到的部分闭合状态不同。当环处于闭合或中间状态时，催化残基更可能彼此靠近，这对催化过程至关重要。此外，我们发现底物结合到同源二聚体的一个原体上，会增加该结合原体中中间状态的频率，同时也会影响未结合原体柔性环的结构倾向性。通过动态网络分析，我们识别出连接同源二聚体两个活性位点的多个变构通路。这些通路的共同点是一个涉及N端（构成结合口袋一部分的关键区域）的变构热点。综合来看，我们模拟研究的结果为COVID-19这一主要药物靶点中柔性环与底物结合之间的关系提供了详细见解。
